GOV-F-003-S45.title: Brain Lock Schema and Contract Definition
GOV-F-003-S45.description: Define the Brain lock data model including lock_id, owner_id, created_at, expires_at (TTL), and recovery metadata. Establish contract for lock persistence and retrieval in MongoDB with TTL index support.

GOV-F-003-S46.title: Brain Lock API and Recovery Endpoints
GOV-F-003-S46.description: Expose backend methods or endpoints for lock acquisition, renewal, inspection, and forced recovery (admin/system-triggered). Ensure ownership validation and safe override behavior aligned with governance rules.
